title: Sri Mahamariamman Temple, Kuala Lumpur
geometryBasis: Named temple envelope and street gate in OpenStreetMap, four verified photographs from the same 2007 visit, and the tourism authority’s approximately 22-metre tower height.
sectionBasis: The five-tier gopuram, open gate and two relief-filled street façades follow the photographs. The lower rear range follows the mapped footprint.
limitations: The four CC0 photographs date the street appearance to February 18, 2007 and guide the entrance tower, colors and two flanking blue façades.
The tower height and stepped silhouette follow the photographs and the tourism authority’s dimensions. Individual painted figures, panel decoration, lettering and unseen roof sections are simplified.

The mapped outline anchors the temple and approximate rear hall. The original elevation field is preserved. The coarse urban surface rises along the northern side, so contact and visible plinth heights are approximate.
